The '''Kindlabethia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Braxant sector/Legends|Braxant sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kindlabethia]].
